'''Silvarea''' is a small area in the north-eastern corner of [[Misthalin]]. Primarily consisting of a path between two mountain ranges, it ends at the [[Paterdomus Temple]], behind which is the [[River Salve]].

== Transportation ==
Several teleports bring players close to Silvarea, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:

* {{Plink|Digsite pendant}} — [[Digsite]], south-west of the area.
* {{Plink|Lumberyard teleport}} and {{plink|ring of the elements}} — [[Lumberyard]], west of Silvarea.
* {{Plink|Salve Graveyard Teleport}}, {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|CKS}}, and {{Plink|Slayer ring}} — [[Morytania]], near the east end of Silvarea. With level 65 [[Agility]], the [[ornate railing]] shortcut by the Paterdomus Temple allows quick passage between Morytania and Silvarea.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Varrock Museum|Modern Day Morytania|The Sleeping Seven}}

After the fall of Zaros, there was little activity in the land now known as Silvarea. However, when [[Lowerniel Drakan|Lord Drakan]] attempted to conquer [[Misthalin]] from the sparse [[human]] settlements in the area, Silvarea became the site of multiple battles. After many years of conflict, the [[Seven Priestly Warriors]] were able to push the hordes of [[Morytania]] away from Misthalin, at the site of what is now the temple of [[Paterdomus]]. The warriors then performed a ritual over the [[River Salve]], preventing [[vampyres]] from being able to cross over it, and ending the [[Misthalin - Morytania War]].

The warriors rest in under the Paterdomus temple today, which was built in their honour. The temple is currently managed by Drezel, although has been subject to attack by Zamorakian forces.

== Features ==
[[File:Paterdomus Temple.png|thumb|The Paterdomus temple.]]
The most notable feature of Silvarea is the [[Paterdomus Temple]], a massive temple on the banks of the [[River Salve]]. The [[Limestone Mine]] is tucked away in the mountain pass of Silvarea, as well as the [[Odd Old Man]]'s house. The entrance to [[Zemouregal's Base]] can also be found in the western cliffside.

Besides the major features, the pathway through Silvarera is lined with a number of regular [[trees]], and its many bats make it a popular location for [[Slayer tasks]]. There are no item spawns in this area.

== Inhabitants ==
=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Arrav}}, a former hero once known for saving Varrock, now re-animated by the evil [[Zemouregal]].
* {{Chatl|Drezel}}, a monk single-handedly running the large [[Paterdomus temple]].
* {{Chatl|Elias White}}, an explorer hoping to find out more about the [[Mahjarrat]].
* {{Chatl|Odd Old Man|txt=Odd old man}}, a strange old man who claims to collect bones for the [[Natural history quiz|Varrock Museum]], but likely has more sinister uses.
* {{Chatl|Shadowy figure|pic=Shadowy figure (1) chathead|txt=Shadowy figures}}, two furry humanoids that [[Darkness of Hallowvale#Urgent business|cause trouble around the temple]].
* {{Chatl|Sharathteerk}}, a loyal right-hand man (or rather, [[gargoyle]]) to Zemouregal.
* {{Chatl|Zemouregal}}, a [[Zamorakian]] [[Mahjarrat]] who aims to take over [[Varrock]] by controlling the hero [[Arrav]].

=== Monsters ===

* [[Bat]] (x13)
* [[Monk of Zamorak]] (x10)
* [[Temple Guardian|Spots, the temple guardian]]
* [[Armoured zombie]] (x41)
